frames.first_prompt_cn: 殷夫人侧身站在天井中，一手按在后腰、一手托着肚子下缘，一只脚刚抬起，低头看自己的肚子，带一点疲惫的笑；藕荷交领长衣被大肚子顶得鼓起；背景是青砖人字纹地面、六根朱柱、三级石阶、石井与挂鸟笼的老梅树；傍晚暖光从左侧；中景侧向、1.5 米高、完整全身。
frames.first_prompt_en: Lady Yin side-on in the centre-right of the courtyard, one hand in her lower back, the other under her belly, one foot lifted mid-step, head bowed toward the bump with a tired small smile; dusty-pink crossed-collar robe with cream inner collar, deep brown belt and wrist wraps, deep grey-green trousers, very large pregnancy; herringbone grey brick, six vermilion columns, three-step stair, stone well, old plum tree with one empty birdcage; warm late-afternoon light from frame left; medium side view at 1.5m, 35mm, full body.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 侍女在画面左侧，双手端木盆、水满到盆沿，侧头盯着右侧夫人的肚子；夫人右侧站定、肚子平顺、神情放松；两人之间一段青砖；暖光从左；中景固定。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 同一机位、同一光线；夫人肚子顶出一个圆鼓包、衣料绷成弧面，她眉头一皱、嘴张开；侍女肩膀一耸、木盆前倾，一道水刚离盆沿、悬在空中。
frames.first_prompt_en: Frame left the household maid in pale lotus-white and grey-green cotton with a cloth headband, eyes as two plain dots, holding a wooden basin of water at waist height and staring at the woman; frame right Lady Yin standing side-on, belly smooth under the dusty-pink robe, face calm; warm late-afternoon light from frame left; medium-wide at 2m, 35mm, both full body with brick between them.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same framing and positions: one hard round bulge pushes out of Lady Yin belly at a single point, the robe stretched into a dome, her brows down and lips parted; the maid shoulders up, eyes wide, basin tilted forward with a thin arc of water hanging off the rim; brick, columns and stair unchanged.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 李靖蹲在夫人身边、两只脚跟落地、一手撑在膝上，耳朵离肚子还有一掌、正要凑过去，眼睛已经在闭；夫人侧身站着，一手轻搭在他后脑，低头看他；中近景从膝盖以上。
frames.first_prompt_en: Li Jing crouched on both heels beside Lady Yin, one hand flat on his knee, ear still a hand width from her belly and already closing his eyes; dark indigo robe with iron-grey mountain-pattern half armour, black crown over a topknot, neat short beard, black-sheathed sword at his hip; Lady Yin standing above him side-on with one hand falling toward the back of his head; warm light from frame left; medium at 1.1m, 50mm, both from the knees up.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 李靖蹲着、耳朵贴紧夫人肚子、眼睛闭着、一手撑膝；夫人站着、一手搭在他后脑；中近景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 李靖坐在地上、两手平撑在身后的砖上、上身倒着、头仰起、眼睛瞪大、嘴张开、黑冠歪了一点、剑鞘甩到腿边；夫人上身转向他、一只手还按着肚子、嘴微张。
frames.first_prompt_en: Li Jing crouched on both heels with his ear pressed flat against Lady Yin belly, one hand on his knee, eyes closed, perfectly still, the black sheath hanging straight at his hip; Lady Yin standing above him side-on, one hand on his head; medium at 1.1m, 50mm, both from the knees up.
frames.last_prompt_en: Li Jing sitting on the grey brick, both palms flat on the paving behind him, legs folded in front, head snapped up, eyes wide, mouth open, black crown slightly askew, the sword sheath swung against his thigh; Lady Yin has turned her upper body down toward him, one hand still on her belly, mouth open; same framing.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 李靖坐在地上、两手撑在身后；侍女左侧站着、一只手已经抬到嘴边；身后榻沿空着；中景两人同框。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 李靖已站直、两手拍着袍前襟、下巴抬起、眼睛故意看前方、黑冠扶正；侍女一手捂嘴、肩膀耸到耳根、身子弯着。
frames.first_prompt_en: Li Jing sitting on the brick with both palms behind him and his head still up; at frame left the maid with one hand already lifting toward her mouth; the couch edge behind them empty; medium-wide at 1.3m, 35mm, two figures inside frame.
frames.last_prompt_en: Li Jing standing upright, both hands patting down the front of his dark indigo robe, chin lifted, eyes blank and forward, crown straight, sword neat at his hip; the maid at frame left with a hand clamped over her mouth and shoulders up, bent with laughter; the couch edge empty behind them.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 夫人一肩靠着朱柱、仰头笑、眼睛眯成缝、一手按在柱上、一手搭在肚子上；中景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 同一姿势；笑已经没了、眉毛拧紧、嘴唇压成一条线、眉心一道竖纹、鬓角一层汗；两手都按在肚子上、手指张开压进衣料；上身微微前倾离柱。
frames.first_prompt_en: Lady Yin with one shoulder against a vermilion column at frame right, laughing openly with her eyes crinkled shut, one hand flat on the column and the other on top of her very large belly; dusty-pink crossed-collar robe, cream inner collar, silver hairpin in a low bun; warm light from frame left; medium at 1.4m, 50mm, full body with the column up the right edge.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same framing, same column, same figure: the laugh gone, brows drawn hard together, lips pressed thin, a vertical crease between the eyes, a thin line of sweat at her temple; both hands clamped flat on her belly with fingers spread and pressing in, shoulders hunched, body bent slightly away from the column.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 深夜内堂卧房；左侧矮榻上夫人盖薄被、侧身睡、脸松弛；右侧窄小榻上李靖和衣躺着、一臂枕在脑后、眼睛闭着、黑鞘靠在榻腿；中间矮几上一盏油灯；全景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 夫人蜷起、双膝抬高、两手死按肚子、薄被甩到地上、头发散出髻、脸扭曲嘴张开；李靖已坐直、一手撑榻沿、一手伸向她、眼睛睁大、赤脚落地、剑留在榻上；灯火被带得斜了。
frames.first_prompt_en: Night interior: Lady Yin asleep on the low couch at frame left under a thin quilt, face slack and calm, very large belly under the cloth; Li Jing fully clothed in dark indigo robe on the narrow cot at frame right, one arm behind his head, eyes closed, black sheath against the cot leg; one oil lamp between them, the rest of the room in deep cool shadow; wide at 1.4m, 35mm.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same room and framing: Lady Yin curled with knees drawn high, both hands clamped on her belly, quilt thrown on the floor, hair loose, face screwed up and mouth open; Li Jing bolt upright on the cot, one hand on the cot edge, the other reaching to her, eyes wide, bare feet on the floor, sword left behind; lamp flame dragged sideways.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 李靖坐在榻沿、俯身、一手扶住夫人肩膀、一手撑在榻上；夫人仰头看他、满脸汗、两手还按着肚子；他目光还停在她脸上；中近景半身。
frames.first_prompt_en: Li Jing sitting on the edge of the couch bent over Lady Yin, one hand flat on her shoulder and the other on the mattress, his face close to hers and still turned to her; Lady Yin looking up at him, sweaty, hair loose, both hands on her belly; night lamp glow; medium close at 1.3m, 50mm, both from the waist up with the dark door at the right edge.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 李靖站在紧闭的房门前、一手按在门框上、上身半转向门外、领口敞开露出铁灰甲、嘴已经张开要喊、另一手提着剑鞘；门还关着。
frames.first_prompt_en: Li Jing standing at the closed double door, one hand flat on the door frame, body half turned toward the corridor, the collar of his dark indigo robe hanging open over the iron-grey half armour, mouth already opening to shout, the black sheath in his other hand; night lamp glow; medium at 1.5m, 35mm, him at frame left and the door filling the right half.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 回廊一点透视；远处消失点附近一个很小的身影——老管家提着一只袍角朝镜头跑来；深褐灰棉袍、布头巾、腰间一串钥匙；全景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 管家已经跑到三米处停住、两只脚站定、上身半转回去、一条胳膊高高扬起朝身后招、腰间钥匙串甩起来。
frames.first_prompt_en: Corridor in one-point perspective at night, three red lanterns overhead and three warm pools on the round stone plinths, the lower half in cool blue moonlight; far near the vanishing point a small figure of an elderly steward in deep-brown and grey cotton with a cloth headband and a ring of keys, face out of focus, running toward the camera with one hand lifting his hem; wide at 1.5m, 24mm, deep focus to the far window.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same corridor and camera axis: the steward now three metres from the camera, both feet planted, body half turned back, one arm raised and waving forward over his shoulder, mouth open, keys swinging at his waist.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 屋内看门：门扇敞开、门外廊道黑、门槛横在画面底部；门框中央空着，只有一只铜盆的弯沿和一叠布的角从门右侧探进来；中景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 家丁已跨过门槛站进屋，双手把盆抱在胸前、臂下夹一叠灰布、一只后脚还留在门槛上、头低着、盆里冒热气。
frames.first_prompt_en: Interior looking at an open doorway at the centre of frame, two leaves against the wall, corridor dark beyond, wooden threshold across the bottom of the opening, grey brick floor in the foreground, lamp light from frame left; the doorway itself empty, only the curved rim of a bronze basin and the corner of a folded grey cloth intruding from the right; medium-wide at 1.5m, 35mm.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same doorway and framing: a household servant in plain grey cotton with a cloth headband and eyes as two plain dots has stepped in over the threshold and stands inside the room, both arms around the bronze basin held against his chest, the grey cloth under one elbow, one back foot still on the threshold, head lowered, steam rising.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 侍女站在门中央、双手抱一只深木药箱在腰高；李靖站在门外右侧、半转身、身体挡住门右半边、一手扶门框；中景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 侍女已跨进门槛、药箱抱在腰侧；李靖整个人贴到右侧门柱上、一肩抵住木头、下巴偏开、门洞让出来。
frames.first_prompt_en: The maid standing in the doorway holding a dark wooden medicine box in both hands at waist height; Li Jing just outside on the right of the opening, half turned toward her and blocking the right half of the doorway with one hand on the door frame; interior lamp light; medium-wide at 1.5m, 35mm, doorway centre third.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same doorway: the maid stepped in past the threshold with the box at her waist; Li Jing flattened against the right door post, one shoulder pressed to the wood, chin turned away, the opening clear between them.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 李靖站在右侧朱柱旁、一手按剑柄、身体正对左边的门、下颚紧、眼睛盯着门；全景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 李靖已离柱三步、正走向画面左侧、一只脚跟刚要落地、上身拧过去、手还在剑柄上、头回望那扇门。
frames.first_prompt_en: Li Jing standing beside a vermilion column at frame right, one hand on the sword hilt, body squared toward the closed door at frame left with a thin warm line at its seam; night corridor with three red lanterns and three warm pools on the plinths, lower half in cool blue moonlight; wide at 1.5m, 35mm, column right edge, door left edge.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same corridor and camera: Li Jing three steps away from the column, mid-stride toward frame left with his heel just landing, torso swung round, the same hand still on the hilt, head turned back over his shoulder toward the door, robe hem swinging behind him.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 三盏红灯笼都烧得亮、柱础上三团暖光清楚、廊子里空无一人、消失点处的纸窗不亮；全景。
frames.first_prompt_en: Night corridor in one-point perspective, three red lanterns burning bright overhead, three full warm pools on the round stone plinths, vermilion columns lit warm, the corridor empty; wide at 1.5m, 24mm.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 两扇旧木门占满画面、门缝垂直居中、门缝里没有任何光、门槛横在下方四分之一、门面上两道旧门栓印痕清楚；固定近景。
frames.first_prompt_en: Two heavy dark wooden door leaves clamped shut and filling the frame, the vertical seam dead centre with no light in it at all, the wooden threshold across the lower quarter, two old bolt scars on the leaf surfaces, everything almost black; fixed close shot at 0.30m above the threshold, 85mm.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 老梅树叶子全部平垂静止、枝上空鸟笼垂直不动、地上的枝影很稳；中景右侧。
frames.first_prompt_en: Old plum tree in the right half of frame, every leaf hanging flat and still, one empty bamboo birdcage hanging dead vertical from a branch, the branch shadow steady on the herringbone grey brick; night courtyard with cool blue moonlight and one far red lantern; medium at 1.4m, 50mm.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 家丁刚跨出门槛、双手端一盆热水、盆上冒白气、头抬着正常往前看；中景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 家丁停在门槛上、低头看门底那道光、眼睛瞪大、肩膀耸起、铜盆向前倾、一泼水刚从盆沿滑出去。
frames.first_prompt_en: The servant just inside the doorway with a bronze basin of steaming water held in both hands at waist height, head lifted, looking straight ahead, one foot ahead of the other mid-step; interior lamp light with a bright red line already under the door at the left edge; medium-wide at 1.5m, 35mm.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same doorway and framing: the servant stopped dead, head dropped toward the red glow under the door, eyes wide, shoulders up around his ears, the basin tipped forward with a sheet of water just leaving the rim and hanging in the air.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 正房两扇门紧闭、门缝一线红光、三级石阶还是暗灰、第二级那道踩出来的凹痕清楚、砖地暗着；全景。
frames.first_prompt_en: The two door leaves clamped shut at the top third of frame with one thin red line at the seam, three stone steps lying dark grey across the lower third, the worn dip in the second step readable, the brick apron dark; wide at 1.2m, 35mm.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 从南墙高位看整座天井：青砖人字纹地面、六根朱柱、三级石阶已被红光染亮、石井、老梅树与鸟笼、白墙都还沉在冷月光里、三盏红灯笼；全景。
frames.first_prompt_en: High wide view of the whole courtyard from the south wall: herringbone grey brick floor, six vermilion columns, three stone steps already washed red at the top of frame, the stone well, the old plum tree with its birdcage, whitewashed walls still in cool moonlight, three red lanterns; wide at 2.2m, 24mm.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 内堂全景：横梁、长条案上五件青瓷、两把高背椅、六扇海浪云纹屏风、纸窗；整间被红光洗成暗红，每件东西都投出硬影；画面无人；全景。
frames.first_prompt_en: Interior wide: beams overhead, a long narrow table with five celadon pieces, two high-backed chairs, a six-panel screen with wave-and-cloud carving, paper windows; the whole room washed a medium red with a hard shadow under every object; wide at 1.5m, 35mm, no figure.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 两扇门紧闭、门缝与门边漏出红光、一只手从里面抓住右扇门的边、指节发白、袖口露出一截藕白棉布；中景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 右扇门被甩开；侍女已扑到门槛外、膝盖正往下折、一只手掌拍在门槛石上撑住、头发散乱盖脸、一只赤脚着地、另一只鞋留在门槛上、红光从她背后涌出来。
frames.first_prompt_en: Both door leaves shut with red leaking at the seam and around the edges, a woman's hand gripping the edge of the right leaf from inside, knuckles white, a cuff of pale lotus cotton at the wrist; interior red-washed lamp light; medium-wide at 1.5m, 35mm, doorway dead centre.
frames.last_prompt_en: The right leaf flung open; the maid already past the threshold with her knees buckling, one palm slapped down on the threshold stone, hair loose across her face, one bare foot outside and one shoe left on the threshold behind her, red light spilling out of the doorway.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 侍女跌坐在门槛上、两手撑在身后的石头上、两条腿折在身下、头低着、头发盖住脸、身后门大开、红光炽烈；中景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 她坐直了、背靠左边门柱、一条胳膊反身伸进门里、食指直直指着、脸白得没有血色、嘴张开、另一只手抓着领口。
frames.first_prompt_en: The maid collapsed on the threshold, both hands flat on the stone behind her, legs folded under her, head hanging and hair over her face, the doorway wide open behind her with red light pouring out; medium at 1.3m, 35mm.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same threshold and framing: she has straightened up with her back against the left door post, one arm twisted back through the opening and pointing straight inside, face bone white, eyes round, mouth open, the other hand at her own collar.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 地砖中段一只光滑肉色的圆球静静坐着，表面柔、没有光泽，砖上只有一圈淡淡红晕，梁影横过地面；低机位近景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 球在砖上转了四分之一圈、顶上多出一道细褶、一圈红光绕着它盘在砖上、亮而不断、红光也爬到球的下半部。
frames.first_prompt_en: A smooth flesh-coloured round mass sitting motionless on the grey brick at the centre of the floor, surface soft and dull with no highlight, only a faint red halo on the stone around it and one beam shadow lying across the paving; low close at 0.5m, 50mm.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same mass now turned a quarter turn with a fine fold wrung out at the top, one ring of red light wound tight round its base and bright, the red climbing partway up its body, the brick around it warmed.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 夫人仰躺在矮榻上、被子踢到膝下、藕荷长衣前襟被汗浸深、头发贴在额上、散出髻、大肚子塌下来、两手摊在身侧、头还朝上、眼睛睁着；中景半身。
frames.first_prompt_en: Lady Yin lying flat on the low couch, quilt kicked down past her knees, dusty-pink robe soaked dark at the front, hair loose and stuck to her forehead, the great belly collapsed soft, both hands loose at her sides, head still turned straight up, eyes open; interior red light; medium close at 1.2m, 50mm, her in the left half of frame.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 李靖站在敞开的门口、一只靴踏在门槛上、剑还在黑鞘里、右手握着鞘口、身体正对屋内、眼睛盯着地上；全景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 李靖已进屋两步、剑抽出来斜垂在右身侧、裸刃上有一道红边、左手里是空鞘、身体转向屋子中央、下颚咬紧。
frames.first_prompt_en: Li Jing standing in the open doorway with one boot on the threshold, the black sheath on his hip and his right hand closed round its mouth, body squared at the room, eyes down on the floor; interior red light; wide at 1.5m, 35mm, him at frame left and the room opening right.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same room and framing: Li Jing two steps inside, the bare blade pulled out and hanging at an angle beside his right thigh with one bright red line along the steel, the empty sheath in his left hand, his body turned toward the centre of the room, jaw set and eyes on the floor.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 李靖把剑举到肩膀高度、刃斜向下、双手握柄、两肘都弯着、脸朝着下前方、眉毛压着、嘴闭着；中景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 剑尖直直指着地上的肉球、刃停稳不动、两手锁在柄上、头低下来、下巴收紧、牙齿咬住、眼睛眯起来盯着球。
frames.first_prompt_en: Li Jing with the blade at shoulder height, both hands locked on the grip, elbows bent, the edge angled down, face aimed down at the floor, mouth closed and brows pressed; interior red light; medium at 1.4m, 50mm, him in the upper two thirds.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same framing: the tip of the blade now hanging directly over the pale mass on the floor, dead still, both hands locked on the grip, his head dropped and chin tucked, teeth clenched, eyes narrowed.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 李靖把剑高高举过头顶、两条手臂伸直、刃朝天、重心压在后腿、肩膀抬起、脸绷紧、眼睛看着地面；中景全身。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 刃已落到球顶、球面被压出一个深深的 V 形凹口、球被压宽、他双臂伸直、上身前压、重心移到前脚、牙露出来、红光顺着刃面往上窜。
frames.first_prompt_en: Li Jing with the blade hauled overhead, both arms straight up, edge at the ceiling, weight on the back leg, shoulders lifted, face set, eyes on the floor below; interior red light; medium at 1.4m, 35mm, whole body in frame.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same framing: the edge landed on the top of the pale mass, sunk in, the soft surface dented into a deep V and the shape squashed wider, his arms rigid and torso pitched forward over the front foot, teeth bared, red light running up the steel.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 肉球还完整地躺在地砖中央，顶上有一道细而干净的裂缝、红光从缝里漏出一条细线、周围砖面被烤成暗红；低机位近景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 球分裂成两瓣、左右分开躺在砖上、中间裂开一道明显的空、两片切面光滑发湿、一道宽宽的红光从缝里喷出来、砖被烧得通红。
frames.first_prompt_en: The pale mass still whole and resting on the grey brick at the centre of the floor, one fine clean crack across its top with a thin red line leaking from it, the brick around it baked dark red; low close at 0.5m, 50mm.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same floor and framing: the mass split into two lobes lying apart on the brick, both cut faces smooth and wet, a wide band of red light blasting up out of the gap between them, the brick around the gap burned bright red.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 两瓣球分开躺在地砖上，中间的缝里只露出一小截头顶（两个小揪揪、红绳）和一只赤脚，红光围着它们烧；低机位近景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 娃娃已经落下：两只赤脚平平踩在砖上、膝盖弯着、右脚踝一圈细金环反光、朱红长绫还裹在身上、绫尾拖在身后的砖上、头低着、两只小拳头按在砖上。
frames.first_prompt_en: Two pale lobes lying apart on the grey brick at the centre of the floor with only a small crown of two topknots tied with red cord and one bare baby foot showing in the gap between them, red light blazing up round them; low close at 0.5m, 50mm.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same floor and framing: the small child landed, both bare feet flat on the brick, knees bent, both fists pressed down on the paving, a deep vermilion silk scarf wrapped round his body with its tail dragging behind him, a fine gold ring at his right ankle, his head bowed.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 哪吒蹲在砖地上、头低着、两只拳头按在地上、朱红长绫在脚边堆着；中景全身。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 哪吒已经站直、身体小而稳、长绫在身后拖出去、两条胳膊垂着、下巴平、眼睛向前、额间三瓣朱红火焰纹清楚。
frames.first_prompt_en: The small child crouched on the brick with his head down, both fists pressed flat on the paving, the vermilion scarf bunched at his feet, the two topknots tied with red cord; interior red light; medium at 0.9m, 50mm, full body.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same framing: the child standing upright and small but steady, both arms hanging at his sides, the vermilion scarf spread out behind him, chin level, eyes forward, the three-lobed red flame mark on his forehead clear, gold ring at his right ankle.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 哪吒站着、头微微低着、嘴闭着、表情严肃、两只脚并拢、拳头在身侧、两瓣球在画面左右边缘；全景全身。
frames.first_prompt_en: The small child standing with his head slightly down, mouth closed, face serious, both feet together, both fists at his sides, the vermilion scarf trailing behind him, the two lobes of the split ball at the left and right edges of frame; interior red light; medium-wide at 0.9m, 50mm.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 李靖剑还举在肩膀高度、手臂弯着、刃斜向下、表情仍然硬、眼睛盯着孩子；中景半身。
frames.first_prompt_en: Li Jing with the sword still up at shoulder height, arm bent, edge angled down, face hard and eyes fixed on the floor; lower left corner shows only the top of the child's head with two topknots; interior red light; medium at 1.4m, 50mm.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 画面左侧娃娃的小手垂在身侧、手指松开、腕上一只宽金镯；右侧李靖的大手握在剑柄上、剑身指向画外；两只手相距一掌、中间看得见砖；手部近景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 娃娃的小手指勾住李靖的一根手指、两处只在那一根上接触、两只手的轮廓在红光里分得清清楚楚、金镯翻过来亮出一道硬边、剑仍握在同一只拳里。
frames.first_prompt_en: At frame left the small child's hand hanging at his side, fingers open, a wide gold bangle at the wrist; at frame right Li Jing's larger hand closed round a sword grip with the blade pointing out of frame; a hand width of grey brick between them; interior red light; close at 0.9m, 85mm, shallow depth of field.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same two hands now touching: one small finger hooked around one of Li Jing's fingers, the contact single and exact, the bangle turned to throw one hard gold edge, the sword still in the same fist.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 夫人一只肘撑在榻上、上身半起、另一条手臂还收在胸前、脸湿、眼睛睁着、嘴唇分开；中景半身。
frames.first_prompt_en: Lady Yin with one elbow braced on the couch, upper body half raised, the free arm still across her own chest, face wet and eyes open, mouth starting to part; interior red light; medium at 1.3m, 50mm, her in the left half of frame.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 哪吒站在画面右侧、面朝左、拳头在身侧、两只脚并拢；夫人左侧榻上撑着、一条手臂伸出来；两人之间两米红砖；全景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 哪吒已走过大半段、离榻两步、身体前倾、两臂张开、一只脚抬着、长绫在身后拖着；夫人的手已经到了他脸旁、五指张开。
frames.first_prompt_en: Frame right the small child standing with his body facing left, both fists at his sides, feet together, the vermilion scarf trailing behind him; frame left Lady Yin leaning up from the couch with one arm out; two metres of red brick between them; wide at 1.2m, 35mm.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same framing: the child two steps from the couch with his body tipped forward and both arms spread wide for balance, one foot lifted, the scarf dragging; her outstretched hand has reached the height of his face with the fingers open.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 哪吒离榻两步、两臂张开；夫人半撑起身、两臂朝他张开、满脸泪、头发散着；中景。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 哪吒贴在她胸前、她左臂绕过他的背、右手按在他后脑、他的脸埋在她肩窝、小手抓着她的衣领、长绫垂在榻沿外；两个人身体并排不重叠。
frames.first_prompt_en: The child two steps from the couch with both arms spread wide and body tipped forward; Lady Yin up on one elbow with both arms open and tears wet on both cheeks, dusty-pink robe soaked dark, hair loose; interior red light; medium at 1.2m, 50mm, both figures side by side.
frames.last_prompt_en: Same framing: the child fallen into her chest with his face pressed into the hollow of her shoulder and his hands on her collar, her left arm round his back and her right hand flat on the back of his head, his feet off the brick, the vermilion scarf hanging off the couch edge, tears running.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 哪吒右腕斜横在画面上、宽宽的哑光金镯套在腕上、没有反光、手指松着、腕后有一段朱红绫褶；大特写。
frames.first_prompt_en: The child's right wrist lying across the lower frame with a wide matte gold bangle at the wrist showing no reflection, the fingers loose, a fold of vermilion silk behind the wrist; interior red light, shallow depth of field; extreme close at 0.3m, 100mm macro.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 小赤脚旁的砖地上，朱红长绫的末端平铺着、边角磨得起毛、颜色深而哑、画面左侧露出一点细金脚环；近景略俯。
frames.first_prompt_en: The tail of a deep vermilion silk scarf lying flat on the grey brick beside two small bare feet, its corners worn fuzzy, the colour matte, the edge of a thin gold ankle ring just outside the left edge of frame; interior red light, slightly high angle; close at 0.4m, 85mm.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 三层云海；下中一块平云台、边缘一道翻卷的云舌；下方城屋顶缩成指甲盖、画面左下一盏小红灯笼；云台上坐着白胡子老道、月白宽袖道袍带银云纹、长白须垂到胸口、玉簪、腰挂葫芦、布鞋、白拂尘横在膝上、双眼闭着；全景。
frames.first_prompt_en: A high wide view of three white cloud layers, a flat cloud platform at the centre with one curling cloud tongue running off its right edge, a tiny city of grey roofs far down in the lower left with one small red lantern dot; on the platform an old white-bearded immortal in a moon-white wide-sleeved robe with silver cloud patterns, long white beard to his chest, jade hairpin and a gourd at his waist, cloth shoes, a white horsetail whisk across his knees, eyes closed; cool high-altitude light, wide at 1.4m, 35mm.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 老道盘腿坐着、两眼睁开、面带微笑、拂尘横在膝上、云台边的云舌平着不动、城在下方；全景。
frames.first_prompt_en: The immortal sitting cross-legged with both eyes open and a smile, the white whisk across his knees, the cloud tongue at the platform edge lying flat and still, the city tiny at the lower left; cool high-altitude light; wide at 1.4m, 35mm, same composition as the preceding shot.

frames.first_prompt_cn: 从稍远处看：老道小小的坐在平云台中央、下巴低着、云舌向外卷、三层云海上下叠着、城在画面左下缩成一小块、一点红光；广角。
frames.last_prompt_cn: 机位已经远得多：云台缩成云海中央一枚小小的浅色圆盘、老道已经看不清人形、下方的城只剩一粒灰点、一点红光。
frames.first_prompt_en: From a little further out: the immortal small on the flat cloud platform at the centre with his head dipped, the cloud tongue unrolled off the right edge, three cloud layers stacked, the city tiny at the lower left with one red dot; cool high-altitude light; wide at 1.6m, 24mm.
frames.last_prompt_en: From far out: the platform shrunk to a pale disc at the centre of the cloud sea, the immortal no longer readable as a figure, the city only a single grey speck with one point of red, three cloud layers filling the entire frame.
